# jamfplatform_pro_pki_digicert (Data Source)

Look up a Jamf Pro DigiCert Trust Lifecycle Manager integration by ID. The certificate bytes and password are never exposed — Jamf Pro does not return them on read.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Grant the API integration the following permissions in Jamf Account — see [Getting started with the Platform API](https://developer.jamf.com/platform-api/reference/getting-started-with-platform-api). `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Infrastructure | DigiCert Trust Lifecycle Manager | Read | `digicert-settings` |



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) DigiCert integration ID to look up.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `client_certificate_details` (Attributes) Read-only metadata Jamf Pro derives from the stored client certificate. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--client_certificate_details))
- `display_name` (String) Display name for the integration.
- `host_name` (String) DigiCert One host name.
- `revocation_enabled` (Boolean) Whether certificate revocation is enabled.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--client_certificate_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `client_certificate_details`

Read-Only:

- `expiration_date` (String) The certificate expiry as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `filename` (String) The stored certificate filename.
- `issuer` (String) The certificate issuer distinguished name.
- `serial_number` (String) The certificate serial number.
- `subject` (String) The certificate subject distinguished name.
